title: CrosssellReorderPromptedPayload
description: Payload of `crosssell.reorder.prompted` version 1: a customer who orders from a category at a steady interval, consented to marketing pushes and keeps recommendations on, was prompted that its time came; at most one prompt a day. The notifications module sends the push. The envelope's `partner_id` is `null`. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

item_id.description: What the customer last ordered from it.

interval_days.description: The customer's usual interval, in days.

last_ordered_at.description: When the customer last ordered from it.
